observations: The previous entrance fanlight was a large black void with ten heavy radial spokes. It is replaced with a smaller, lower arched opening, solid colored glazing, curved rails and finer spokes. The double door has separate lower panels, upper glazing, stiles, rails, grilles and pull handles.

The side arched window and partial left rectangular window were rebuilt. The broad window on the right is now three distinct glazed openings separated by wall piers, rather than a continuous generic grid. All replacement components are volumetric geometry.

The third large window was initially clipped by the old 15/16 bay boundary, causing an approximately 3.18-pixel center error. The lower facade now extends across that boundary. A bounded geometric subtraction trims the crossing old wall and partition surfaces, preserving their portions outside the cut volume. The final maximum top/base anchor error is 1.472 pixels at 708x1000 over the five non-clipped units, within the 1.5-pixel manual uncertainty; this does not prove complete visual fidelity.

The room slab originally sat above the observed entrance threshold. The original bay wedge slabs were removed and the floor was lowered, with wall-foot extensions behind the facade. All nine downward probes land on the new floor at threshold height. Thirty-six opening probes find no remaining structural blocker in front of the new glass.

The original misplaced upright bench and wide staircase were removed as complete welded components: 16 bench components with 192 triangles and seven stair components with 84 triangles. The first nominal bounding-box removal had left steel legs and cheek blocks; the final local render confirms their removal. New treads are narrower, shifted slightly right, and have sloping side cheeks.

151 added solids with 22612 triangles pass closed-volume and saved/reopened vertex checks. Preserved original face positions and UVs, shared node groups, all 23 packed images, and movie/night scene state match the v49 source. The character and spatial-portal setup were not changed.

Front, reference comparison, full courtyard oblique, close oblique and window-boundary detail renders were inspected. Glazing remains colored from fixed reference UVs; true changing reflections, irregular broken glass, subtle grille details, facade wear and inferred interior details still require refinement. Oversized nearby leaves, the low pipe, air-conditioning units, ground stones and surrounding debris remain visibly different from the poster.

Positions, normals and UVs match the native export, other geometry/ivy are retained, and 26 HTTP resources match local bytes.
